key.name: open-palette
key.summary: Keybinding that opens the Vixzen Palette
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the keyboard-first command palette. Empty disables the shortcut (the bar button still works).

key.name: show-bar
key.summary: Show the Vixzen bottom bar and Start Menu
key.description: Off by default so dash-to-dock owns the taskbar and only the Palette is active. Turn on to replace the dock with the Vixzen bar, Start Menu, and pinned apps.
